title: Affordable Udaipur Tour Package with Hotels & Sightseeing
bestFor: Couples, Small Families, Solo Travellers & First-Time Visitors
overview: Looking for a budget-friendly escape to Rajasthan? Safar Trails brings you an exclusive Udaipur tour package at just ₹7,999 for 2 nights and 3 days, customised for travelers who want the full City of Lakes experience without stretching their wallet. This Udaipur tour package covers comfortable hotel stays, guided sightseeing, and hassle-free transfers — everything bundled into one simple price by a team that knows Udaipur inside out. Udaipur, often called the "Venice of the East," is one of India's most romantic and photogenic cities. With Safar Trails, you don't have to worry about planning routes, booking hotels separately, or negotiating with local cabs — everything is arranged so you can simply land, relax, and enjoy.

itinerary.title: Delhi → Udaipur | Arrival, Lake Pichola & Gangaur Ghat
itinerary.description: Morning departure from Delhi by private vehicle (or pickup on arrival in Udaipur). En-route breakfast/refreshment break. Arrival in Udaipur and hotel check-in. In the evening, visit Lake Pichola, scenic Gangaur Ghat, the Old City and local handicraft markets. Dinner and overnight stay in Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Udaipur Sightseeing | City Palace, Fateh Sagar & Sajjangarh
itinerary.description: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the grand City Palace complex, ancient Jagdish Temple, Saheliyon Ki Bari royal garden, and Fateh Sagar Lake. Following a lunch break, ascend to Sajjangarh (Monsoon Palace) for stunning sunset views. In the evening, enjoy free time for café hopping, shopping, or an optional sunset boat ride on Lake Pichola. Dinner and overnight stay in Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Udaipur → Delhi | Old City Walk & Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and complete hotel check-out. Enjoy a last-minute stroll or souvenir shopping in the Old City if time permits. Depart for Delhi by private vehicle (or drop at Udaipur airport/railway station), with en-route refreshment breaks. Arrive in Delhi by evening/night. Tour Ends.

faqs.question: Is this Udaipur tour package customizable?
faqs.answer: Yes. Safar Trails can adjust the itinerary, number of days, hotel category (from budget/3★ to 4★ boutique heritage properties or lake-view luxury suites), and transportation on request.

faqs.question: Does the package include flight or train tickets?
faqs.answer: No, the ₹7,999 package covers local stay, private vehicle transfers, and sightseeing. Airport or railway station pickup and drop are included once you arrive in Udaipur.

faqs.question: Is this Udaipur tour package suitable for families with kids?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. The itinerary is relaxed and includes family-friendly attractions like Saheliyon Ki Bari fountains, peaceful boat rides on Lake Pichola, and wide promenade walks along Fateh Sagar Lake.

faqs.question: Why is ₹7,999 a great deal for a 3-day Udaipur trip?
faqs.answer: Arranging hotels, private cabs, and daily transfers independently often costs significantly more. Safar Trails bundles verified comfortable accommodation, dedicated vehicle with driver, and sightseeing into one fixed transparent rate with no hidden charges.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Udaipur?
faqs.answer: October to March offers pleasant, sunny days and cool evenings, making it the ideal season for palace exploration and lake boat cruises.
